mapper.insert: insert into ontology_proposal (proposal_name, proposal_type, task_id, config_json, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{proposalName}, 'ONTOLOGY_BUNDLE', #{taskId}, #{configJson}, 'DRAFT', #{username}, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update ontology_proposal set config_json = #{configJson}, status = 'DRAFT', review_by = null, review_time = null, review_comment = null, update_by = #{username}, update_time = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId} and proposal_id = #{proposalId}
